paragraphs.notes: Continuation page inside the Patentansprueche. The whole body is one unbroken enumeration of substituent group names: it opens mid-list at "Heteroarylalkinylsulfonyl" (the previous page, printed 90, ends "...Heteroarylalkenylsulfonyl,") and it ends mid-word at "Heteroarylalkylsulfonyl-N-", with no terminating punctuation; the next page, printed 92, opens "alkyl-amino, ...". The patent carries no [00NN] paragraph markers, so marker is null. The zh field holds the verbatim German, as this is a German-language WO publication and not Chinese; almost every token here is a chemical group name rather than German prose, and the only German words on the page are the connectives "gegebenenfalls substituiertes", "Mono-" and "oder", so en differs from zh mainly in those connectives, in lower-casing the group names and in rendering German "Alkinyl" as English "alkynyl". The transcription joins the 34 printed lines into flowing text; where a line ended with a word-internal hyphen ("N-Alkyl-N-" + "heteroarylaminosulfonyl", "Alkenylsulfonyl-N-Alkyl-" + "amino") the halves are joined without a space, and the trailing "Heteroarylalkylsulfonyl-N-" of the last line is left as printed. Standalone hyphens in "Mono- oder" are as printed. Printed as-is and not corrected: the sulfonyl-N-alkyl-amino series is inconsistently capitalised, "Alkylsulfonyl-N-alkyl-amino" then five members with capital "N-Alkyl-" (Alkenyl-, Alkinyl-, Cycloalkyl-, Cycloalkylalkyl-, Cycloalkylalkenyl-) and then lower-case "N-alkyl-" again from Cycloalkylalkinylsulfonyl onward; and the last line breaks the parallel order, giving "Arylsulfonyl-N-alkyl-amino, Heteroarylsulfonyl-N-alkyl-amino, Arylalkylsulfonyl-amino", where the Arylalkyl member both comes after the Heteroaryl member and is printed "-amino" rather than "-N-alkyl-amino". This page reprints, word for word, the list printed on page 19 of the description (PDF p21); the claims repeat the description's substituent definitions verbatim. A small ink speck sits above the line just after "Cycloalkylalkinylsulfinyl," on printed line 3; it is a scan artifact, not a character. The bottom third of the page below the last line is blank and there is no footer.
